title: isodon polystachys
intro: Isodon polystachys, commonly known as 'Himalayan Chrysanthemum', is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae, native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The plant is said to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can help to boost the immune system and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Isodon polystachys include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities.
